assets.concept: A grand dining-hall king whose giant round mahogany serving table forms his torso and wide ruffled tablecloth forms a royal cape. His expressive face is a silver serving platter with tiny delighted eyes, moustache made of curled napkins, a teapot crown and four carved table legs with polished shoes. Long fork-and-spoon arms welcome guests. Rich wood grain, silver reflections and embroidered linen, extravagant but funny original object king.
